identity.title: Runtime, Observatory, polis, and protocol sprint

values.task_boundary: Prepare and operate only the runtime-observatory-polis-protocol sprint umbrella; do not implement its child issues.
deliverables: Sprint Execution Packet with membership, lanes, gates, review path, and activity log
Integrated sprint review and truthful umbrella closeout record
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: The Sprint Execution Packet records exact child membership and dependency order.
AC-2: Safe parallel lanes and serial gates are explicit and do not overlap child ownership.
AC-3: The umbrella coordinates only; each child retains implementation, proof, review, publication, and closeout authority.
AC-4: Every child handoff requires issue-bound bind, readiness, and session-goal truth before implementation.
AC-5: Integrated sprint review and umbrella closeout occur only after every child reaches truthful terminal state.
non_goals: Collapsing child review or publication into the umbrella
Claiming parallel execution beyond the declared packet
